SELECT l.id AS loca_id, l.loca_code, l.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, l.warehouse_area_id, a.name AS area_name, a.category AS area_category, l.tunnel_number, l.shelf_number, l.layer_number, l.position_number, l.loca_status, l.storage_condition, l.allow_mix_sku, l.allow_mix_batch, l.fixed_sku_id, IFNULL(inv.total_count, 0) AS total_count, IFNULL(inv.total_count, 0) AS current_count, IFNULL(inv.available_count, 0) AS available_count, IFNULL(inv.locked_count, 0) AS locked_count, IFNULL(inv.frozen_count, 0) AS frozen_count, inv.batch_number, COALESCE(inv.sku_id, l.fixed_sku_id) AS bound_sku_id, sku.code AS sku_code, COALESCE(sku.title, sku.spec) AS sku_name, spu.title AS spu_name, CASE WHEN IFNULL(inv.total_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_occupied, CASE WHEN IFNULL(inv.sku_type_count, 0) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_mixed FROM wms_warehouse_area_loca l LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse_area a ON a.id = l.warehouse_area_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT warehouse_area_loca_id, SUM(total_count) AS total_count, SUM(available_count) AS available_count, SUM(locked_count) AS locked_count, SUM(frozen_count) AS frozen_count, MAX(batch_number) AS batch_number, MAX(sku_id) AS sku_id, COUNT(DISTINCT sku_id) AS sku_type_count FROM wms_inventory WHERE is_del = 1 GROUP BY warehouse_area_loca_id ) inv ON inv.warehouse_area_loca_id = l.id LEFT JOIN wms_item_sku sku ON sku.id = COALESCE(inv.sku_id, l.fixed_sku_id) LEFT JOIN wms_item_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id WHERE l.is_del = 1
AND l.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}
AND l.warehouse_area_id = #{q.warehouseAreaId}
AND l.loca_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.locaCode}, '%')
AND l.loca_status = #{q.locaStatus}
AND IFNULL(inv.total_count, 0) > 0
AND IFNULL(inv.total_count, 0) = 0
AND (inv.sku_id = #{q.skuId} OR l.fixed_sku_id = #{q.skuId})
AND ( sku.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.skuKeyword}, '%') OR sku.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.skuKeyword}, '%') OR spu.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.skuKeyword}, '%') )
AND ( sku.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.spuKeyword}, '%') OR spu.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.spuKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY l.warehouse_id ASC, l.warehouse_area_id ASC, l.loca_code ASC

SELECT sku.id AS sku_id, spu.id AS spu_id, spu.sub_title AS spu_code, spu.title AS spu_name, sku.code AS sku_code, sku.code AS bar_code,
#{q.warehouseId} AS warehouse_id, (SELECT name FROM wms_warehouse WHERE id = #{q.warehouseId}) AS warehouse_name,
NULL AS warehouse_id, '全仓汇总' AS warehouse_name,
IFNULL(inv.total_count, 0) AS total_count, IFNULL(inv.loca_count, 0) AS in_stock_loca_count, IFNULL(inv.available_count, 0) AS available_count, IFNULL(inv.locked_count, 0) AS locked_count, IFNULL(inv.frozen_count, 0) AS frozen_count, IFNULL(unload.pending_unload_count, 0) AS pending_unload_count, IFNULL(psort.pending_sort_count, 0) AS pending_sort_count, IFNULL(sortd.sorted_count, 0) AS sorted_count, IFNULL(shortage.shortage_count, 0) AS shortage_count FROM wms_item_sku sku JOIN wms_item_spu spu ON spu.id = sku.spu_id AND spu.is_del = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sku_id, SUM(total_count) AS total_count, COUNT(DISTINCT warehouse_area_loca_id) AS loca_count, SUM(available_count) AS available_count, SUM(locked_count) AS locked_count, SUM(frozen_count) AS frozen_count FROM wms_inventory WHERE is_del = 1
AND warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}
GROUP BY sku_id ) inv ON inv.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.sku_id, SUM(GREATEST(0, d.count - IFNULL(d.received_count, 0))) AS pending_unload_count FROM wms_warehousing_entry_details d JOIN wms_warehousing_entry e ON e.id = d.warehousing_entry_id WHERE e.is_del = 1 AND d.is_del = 1 AND e.status IN (10, 20)
AND e.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}
GROUP BY d.sku_id ) unload ON unload.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.sku_id, SUM(IFNULL(s.count, 0)) AS pending_sort_count FROM wms_warehousing_entry_details_sort s JOIN wms_warehousing_entry_details d ON d.id = s.warehousing_entry_details_id JOIN wms_warehousing_entry e ON e.id = d.warehousing_entry_id WHERE s.is_del = 1 AND e.is_del = 1 AND s.status = 1
AND e.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}
GROUP BY s.sku_id ) psort ON psort.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.sku_id, SUM(IFNULL(s.count, 0)) AS sorted_count FROM wms_warehousing_entry_details_sort s JOIN wms_warehousing_entry_details d ON d.id = s.warehousing_entry_details_id JOIN wms_warehousing_entry e ON e.id = d.warehousing_entry_id WHERE s.is_del = 1 AND e.is_del = 1 AND s.status = 2
AND e.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}
GROUP BY s.sku_id ) sortd ON sortd.sku_id = sku.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT od.sku_id, SUM(GREATEST(0, od.out_count - IFNULL(od.allocated_count, 0))) AS shortage_count FROM wms_outbound_order_details od JOIN wms_outbound_order o ON o.id = od.outbound_order_id WHERE od.is_del = 1 AND o.is_del = 1 AND o.status NOT IN (80, 90, 91) AND od.out_count > IFNULL(od.allocated_count, 0)
AND o.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}
GROUP BY od.sku_id ) shortage ON shortage.sku_id = sku.id WHERE sku.is_del = 1
AND spu.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.spuCode}, '%')
AND spu.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.spuName}, '%')
AND sku.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.skuCode}, '%')
AND ( spu.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR spu.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR sku.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY spu.id DESC, sku.id ASC
